hudson.model.TextParameterDefinition.name: bucket_s3_names
hudson.model.TextParameterDefinition.description: all buckets in this account for this acronym, enter delimited i.e. nih-nhlbi-topmed-freeze9-batch3-phs001040-c1 nih-nhlbi-topmed-freeze9-batch3-phs001040-c2

hudson.tasks.Shell.command:
#!/usr/bin/env bash set -euo pipefail
mkdir -p downloads
# Simple AWS S3 optimizations (keeps aws s3 cp) export AWS_MAX_ATTEMPTS="${AWS_MAX_ATTEMPTS:-10}" export AWS_RETRY_MODE="${AWS_RETRY_MODE:-adaptive}" export AWS_S3_MAX_CONCURRENT_REQUESTS="${AWS_S3_MAX_CONCURRENT_REQUESTS:-64}" export AWS_S3_MAX_QUEUE_SIZE="${AWS_S3_MAX_QUEUE_SIZE:-10000}" export AWS_S3_MULTIPART_THRESHOLD="${AWS_S3_MULTIPART_THRESHOLD:-64MB}" export AWS_S3_MULTIPART_CHUNKSIZE="${AWS_S3_MULTIPART_CHUNKSIZE:-64MB}" export AWS_CLI_CONNECT_TIMEOUT="${AWS_CLI_CONNECT_TIMEOUT:-10}" export AWS_CLI_READ_TIMEOUT="${AWS_CLI_READ_TIMEOUT:-0}"
FLAT_DIR="downloads_flat" rm -rf "$FLAT_DIR" mkdir -p "$FLAT_DIR"
for bucket_s3_name in ${bucket_s3_names}; do aws sts assume-role \ --role-arn "arn:aws:iam::${nhlbi_account_number}:role/nih-nhlbi-TopMed-EC2Access-S3" \ --role-session-name "get-phenotypic-data" > assume-role-output.txt
export AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=$(grep AccessKeyId assume-role-output.txt | cut -d ':' -f 2 | sed 's/[ ,"]//g') export AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=$(grep SecretAccessKey assume-role-output.txt | cut -d ':' -f 2 | sed 's/[ ,"]//g') export AWS_SESSION_TOKEN=$(grep SessionToken assume-role-output.txt | cut -d ':' -f 2 | sed 's/[ ,"]//g')
aws s3 cp --recursive "s3://${bucket_s3_name}/" downloads/ \ --exclude "*" --include "*.txt*" --exclude "SOL_Metabochip*" --include "*.xml*" --no-progress
# FAST "flatten": create a flat view by hardlinking (fast) or copying (fallback) # Output filenames are path-encoded to avoid dupes (README.txt, sample-file.txt, etc.) set +e +o pipefail find downloads/ -type f \( -iname "*.txt*" -o -iname "*.xml*" \) -print0 | while IFS= read -r -d '' f; do rel="${f#downloads/}" safe_rel="${rel//\//__}" out="${FLAT_DIR}/${safe_rel}" ln -f "$f" "$out" 2>/dev/null || cp -f "$f" "$out" done set -euo pipefail
unset AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY AWS_SESSION_TOKEN done
aws sts assume-role --duration-seconds 3600 \ --role-arn arn:aws:iam::736265540791:role/dbgap-etl \ --role-session-name "s3-test" > assume-role-output.txt
export AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=$(grep AccessKeyId assume-role-output.txt | cut -d ':' -f 2 | sed 's/[ ,"]//g') export AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=$(grep SecretAccessKey assume-role-output.txt | cut -d ':' -f 2 | sed 's/[ ,"]//g') export AWS_SESSION_TOKEN=$(grep SessionToken assume-role-output.txt | cut -d ':' -f 2 | sed 's/[ ,"]//g')
cd "$FLAT_DIR"
# Decompress without failing the build if some files already exist / aren’t gz set +e gzip -d -- *.txt.gz set -e
aws s3 cp ./ "s3://avillach-73-bdcatalyst-etl/${study_abv_name,,}/rawData/" --recursive --no-progress
